findings.title: IPC sender check 'origin + pathname equals the packaged index.html file URL' never matches: file: URL origin is "null" (verified), dev adds a trailing slash; invites loosening the only IPC trust check
findings.fix: Compare normalized hrefs with hash/search stripped: pageUrl(senderFrame.url) === pageUrl(dev ? ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL : pathToFileURL(indexHtml).href); reject with 403.

findings.title: Cancel of paused/queued/failed downloads skips TDLib (no live state), leaving partial data in tdlib\files; contradicts Clear All confirm 'Partial downloads are deleted'
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE jobs.action notes; TDLib call map Download pause/cancel; UI.md Queue Clear All
findings.fix: For started (attempts > 0) non-live download jobs being canceled while ready: getMessages (100/call) then deleteFile best effort; ponytail note for offline; update call map row.

findings.title: jobs.pending stores only temp ids; after partial success + crash the file index cannot be recovered, so a sent file is re-posted and an unsent file is marked done
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE schema jobs.pending; Upload steps 3, 4, 6; call map Upload crash recovery
findings.fix: Drop the pending column; store pendingId on each files[i]; settle clears it; startup rebuilds the routing map from files with pendingId && !messageId; extend settleUpload test.

findings.title: Quit/crash during an EXDEV copy leaves a truncated file under the final name; next run saves the real file as ' (2)' and the truncated one stays in the Library
findings.fix: Copy to dot-prefixed <dir>\.teleflow-<jobId>.part (rm stale first), then fs.rename to dest; rm part on error; ponytail note for unswept parts.

findings.title: Skip-existing completion (step 4) does not insert history, so after Clear Completed the item reverts to 'Not downloaded' and dedupe/stats/Library metadata break
findings.fix: Step 4 uses the same complete(job, path) transaction as finalize (job + history row + thumbnail + invalidations), minus move/MOTW/deleteFile; add a test.

findings.title: scans.newest_id 'newest message id indexed' reads as newest media id; in chats ending with text every chats.media call restarts a top-up, flickers the index bar, and loops via media:<chatId> invalidations
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE schema scans; Media index scan start condition and live upkeep
findings.fix: newest_id/oldest_id = newest/oldest message walked (any content); live upkeep bumps newest_id on every updateNewMessage in scanned chats; compare to chat.last_message.id; emit media: on scan state change.

findings.title: supports_streaming is a field of inputVideo, not inputMessageVideo (verified)
findings.fix: { _: 'inputMessageVideo', video: { _: 'inputVideo', video: inputFileLocal, supports_streaming: true }, caption }.

findings.title: Failed album messages have a new id (updateMessageSendFailed.message.id); deleting by temp id leaves them
findings.fix: deleteMessages(chat_id, [update.message.id], revoke: true); pause/cancel keep temp ids for still-pending messages.

findings.title: TDLib-to-shape mappings unstated: Folder.name is chatFolderName object; avatar size; 5 connection states to 4; fileGram.import session type
findings.fix: Folder.name = name.text.text; photo = photo.small.remote.id; Ready/Updating/Connecting+ConnectingToProxy/WaitingForNetwork -> ready/updating/connecting/offline (offline without a client); session: boolean.

findings.title: jobs.action ids up to 50000 exceeds SQLite's 32766 bound-parameter limit (verified)
findings.fix: WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) or cap ids at 1000.

findings.title: electron-builder default npmRebuild may rebuild tdl from binding.gyp (needs Python/MSVC) although its N-API prebuild already loads
findings.fix: Set "npmRebuild": false; confirm in the Phase 1 packaging spike.

findings.title: After a download root change, Show in folder/Open 404 for earlier downloads that still show Downloaded
findings.where: Methods notes library.* path rule; Queue/Chat View reuse of library.reveal
findings.fix: Accept paths inside the root or equal to a completed download's jobs.path/history.path; note in Settings that existing downloads stay where they are.

findings.title: Topic table omits storage on downloadRoot change; window setting writes would emit settings on every drag
findings.where: Events > Who emits which topic; Settings keys
findings.fix: Add 'download root change' to storage; state window writes emit nothing.

findings.title: history 'one row per file' vs 'a final failure inserts one history row'
findings.where: Schema history comment; Transfer engine auto-retry
findings.fix: Completed: one row per file; failed: one row per job (name = job name).

findings.title: chats.media exts scope unstated; Files View with zero rows while scanning would show 'No media in this chat'
findings.fix: exts = distinct ext of the whole chat index (ignores filters); scanning + no rows shows index bar + skeleton rows.

findings.title: downloads.add partial resolution (deleted/no-media/null getMessages results) unspecified
findings.fix: Unresolvable items count as skipped; 404 only for unknown chat; 400 no media only for { link }.

findings.title: Login item survives Clear All Data and uninstall (stale HKCU Run value)
findings.where: Storage Clear All Data; Build NSIS
findings.fix: Clear All Data sets openAtLogin false; assets/installer.nsh customUnInstall deletes HKCU Run 'com.teleflow.app'; confirm value name in Phase 6.

findings.title: Trash matches lower(path) on history and jobs without an index (full scan per file)
findings.fix: CREATE INDEX history_path ON history (lower(path)); CREATE INDEX jobs_path ON jobs (lower(path)) (verified used by the planner).

findings.title: Logout's effect on the queue unstated; jobs run under the next account and fail confusingly
findings.fix: State it with a ponytail note (jobs not tied to an account; upgrade: store me.id on jobs).

findings.title: position 'starts as id' is not expressible in one INSERT; retry keeps the old position implicitly
findings.fix: position = (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(position), 0) + 1 FROM jobs) or UPDATE position = id in the same transaction; state retry order.

findings.title: Unused shape fields: Chat.archived, Message.outgoing, Job.fileCount, Job.attempts, Job.createdAt
findings.fix: Drop them or bind them (e.g. outgoing bubble alignment, '<fileCount> files' on upload cards).
